correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge5\), isolation is equivalent to the absence of four consecutive unselected vertices, hence to selected gaps of length at most four. With \(k=\lceil n/4\rceil\), all minimum sets have deficits \(a_i=4-d_i\) summing to \(r=4k-n\in\{0,1,2,3\}\). Rooting a selected vertex proves the exact count. Removing a selected vertex merges its two gaps to \(L=8-a_--a_+\ge5\); a valid replacement lies at exactly \(9-L\) locations, one the original, giving \(a_-+a_+\) genuine exchanges and uniform total degree \(2r\). For \(r>0\), single-step moves transfer deficit units between neighboring gaps, connect the composition space and circulate one unit to translate the entire configuration by one. Thus all minima are connected; \(r=0\) gives four isolates and \(r=1\) is connected two-regular on \(n\) vertices, hence \(C_n\). The \(n=4\) exception is explicit. Two distinct finite checks passed.

originality.rationale: The 2015 primary source states only the minimum isolation number for cycles, whereas the theorem supplies the exact census, regular degree and component structure for all labelled cycle orders. The 2020 survey covers ordinary domination reconfiguration, which is not the isolating-set feasibility condition. The 2024 isolation paper concerns disjoint isolating sets and sharp general upper bounds. Direct source comparisons, targeted equivalence/alias searches, and accessible earlier scientific claims did not identify a stronger statement implying these results; the possibility of an unindexed equivalent remains noted.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible past research could give an equivalent result using vertex-edge domination, circular binary words, or hard-core-particle terminology.

value.rationale: An isolating set permits undominated individual vertices while ensuring every edge is met by a selected closed neighborhood, a natural sparse monitoring model from Caro--Hansberg. The exact count of optimal placements, the uniform number of legal one-location replacements at every optimum, and the sharp four-periodic transition from total immobility to global reachability are structural invariants not supplied by the known minimum cardinality. One residue family is precisely \(C_n\), supplying an all-parameter metric. This is a complete natural optimal-configuration classification for an infinite family, with a cyclic deficit-transfer structure for further distance or sampling questions; no unproved application is asserted.
